subject: Schedule: ML infra sprint demo & engineer handshake
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamie Ortega <jamie.ortega@cloudpath.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: scheduling ML infra sprint demo & engineering handshake

Hi Jamie — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap: CloudPath is evaluating multi-region inference routing and prefix/KV cache strategies; you flagged throughput for batch workloads and an upcoming compliance review as gating items.

Next step from our side is a 60–90 minute technical run-through so our ML infra and serving engineers can walk through a proposed runbook, capacity profile, and failure/fallback plan. Goal: leave with a mutual action plan and a recommended slot for a Dedicated pilot.

Can you share a few 90-minute windows over the next two weeks that work for your engineering leads? If helpful, we can propose two options and include an agenda + runbook draft.

Attendees we recommend from our side: Ben (ML infra lead), Grace (Ops), Marissa (Solutions). If there are other CloudPath engineers you want on the call, please add them.

Attachments: redwood_runbook_outline.pdf (PDF) — high-level agenda & prep; attendee_matrix.csv (CSV) — proposed participants and roles.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Product Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Jamie Ortega <jamie.ortega@cloudpath.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: scheduling ML infra sprint demo & engineering handshake

Marcus — thanks for the summary and the materials. That runbook outline helps. We're excited to dig in.

Availability from our engineering leads:
- Tue 15 Sep, 10:00–11:30 PT
- Wed 16 Sep, 13:00–14:30 PT (shorter window; can extend)
- Thu 17 Sep, 08:30–10:00 PT

Headcount: Myself, Priya (platform engineer), and a procurement rep for the later-stage contract questions. We'll confirm Priya's attendance tomorrow morning.

Can you send a proposed agenda and who from Redwood will present each section? Also, we prefer a calendar invite with video link and a shared doc for notes.

— Jamie
Jamie Ortega
Sr. Engineering Manager | CloudPath
jamie.ortega@cloudpath.ai | +1 (617) 555-8842
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamie Ortega <jamie.ortega@cloudpath.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: scheduling ML infra sprint demo & engineering handshake

Thanks — appreciate the quick availability. We can do Tue 15 Sep 10:00–11:30 PT. Proposed agenda (90m):

1) 10:00–10:10 — Introductions & goals (Marcus)
2) 10:10–10:35 — Architecture & serving runtime overview (Ben)
3) 10:35–10:55 — Prefix/KV caching, batching, and cost tradeoffs (Grace)
4) 10:55–11:10 — Failure modes, fallback routing & regional failover (Ben + Grace)
5) 11:10–11:25 — Mutual action plan / next steps & pilot milestones (Marcus)
6) 11:25–11:30 — Q&A and logistics (Marissa)

I've attached the runbook outline and attendee matrix again for the prep. Ben and Grace will demo a small capacity/latency profile and show a fallback policy example. Marissa will take notes and capture action items in a shared doc.

Calendar invite and shared doc link will follow after you confirm that Tue 15 at 10:00 PT works. Also flagging a few pre-read asks in the runbook: example traffic profile (p95/p99), allowed RTO for failover, and any compliance evidence you'd like referenced ahead of time.

Attachments: redwood_runbook_outline.pdf, attendee_matrix.csv

Best — Marcus
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Jamie Ortega <jamie.ortega@cloudpath.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: scheduling ML infra sprint demo & engineering handshake

Confirmed from my side — I'll present the runtime slides and live latency profile (synthetic). Ben will also demo the fallback routing example and have the quantization/throughput notes ready.

Quick note for Jamie: if Priya can share a sample request/shape (typical sequence lengths and batch sizes), I can tailor the demo to match CloudPath traffic. If not, the synthetic profile will be representative.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Jamie Ortega <jamie.ortega@cloudpath.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, CloudPath Procurement <procurement@cloudpath.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: scheduling ML infra sprint demo & engineering handshake

Tue 15 Sep 10:00–11:30 PT works for us — thanks for the agenda and the attachments. Priya will join and share a short traffic profile doc before the meeting. Please send the calendar invite and a Google Doc for collaborative notes. Procurement is looped for contract milestone questions but will only stay for the last 10–15 minutes.

See you Tuesday.

— Jamie
